justification: Assessment reported INVALID and its part (b) targets exactly the ground-truth defect: the proof's claim that an odd-length ear forces a monochromatic edge / that an ear's endpoints are automatically red-and-blue. Its witness is a different-but-valid instance of the same claim: in the 3x3 grid (all faces 4-cycles plus outer 8-cycle, so hypothesis holds), after adding ear (1,0)-(1,1)-(1,2), the length-1 ear (0,1)-(1,1) is odd yet its endpoints have i+j parities 1 and 2, i.e. different colors under the proper 2-coloring, so no monochromatic edge appears. Verified concretely; same defect as the ground-truth hexagon-plus-chord witness. The additional point about intermediate regions not being faces of G is a correct elaboration of the same broken parity step.
